title: Unique polynomial interpolation
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type with a finite subset $s$, let $v:\iota\to F$ be injective on $s$, and let $w:\iota\to F$. There is a unique polynomial $p\in F[X]$ of degree less than $|s|$ such that $p(v(i))=w(i)$ for every $i\in s$.
